prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high quality standalone image, an exterior architectural asset reference for image-to-3D reconstruction for EROMASH: Las Runas del Olvido. Subject: Casa de las Lindes, a modest Nordic woodland cartographer's house, distinctive and believable, NOT a tavern or palace. Entire detached building visible, front and right side three-quarter view, camera elevated only 15 degrees, near orthographic long lens, no wide angle distortion. Front faces viewer-left, right gable side faces viewer-right. One rectangular main volume about 8m wide by 6m deep, single tall ground floor with small attic, steep simple blue-grey wooden shingle gabled roof with ridge running left-right across front facade, stone chimney at left end of ridge. Ancient grey-green stone lower walls, clearly readable large blocks, weathered dark timber upper wall extension with exposed structural beams. Main front centered closed plank door framed by a reused ancient stone lintel, two small warm ochre glass windows flanking entrance. Narrow simple front porch canopy BELOW main eaves, supported by two stout timber posts, three broad stone entry steps. Right gable wall: one tall rectangular window and one small attic window. Spare geometric carvings on lintel, pale flat cyan #73D5DB rune inlay, absolutely NO emitted glow, bloom or colored light spill. Quiet stylized dark Nordic fantasy, painterly hand-painted game materials, simplified strong silhouettes and broad surface detail, polished stylized 3D render, expressive but structurally practical, neither photoreal nor cute toy. Palette: dark umber timber, grey-green stone, desaturated blue-grey roof, iron hardware, subdued amber glass. Soft neutral studio illumination exposes ALL wall and roof surfaces, minimal ambient shadow, no baked hard shadows. Seamless light warm grey background and flat unobtrusive ground contact, NO scenic base, no terrain slab. Building centered fills 85% frame, ample margin around chimney and steps, no crop. NO people, animals, creatures, statues, living entities, trees, plants, moss, vines, grass, smoke, fire, fog, furniture outside, barrels, loose clutter, signs, lettering, labels, watermark, collage, panels, cutaway, exploded parts. Exactly one complete coherent house. Prioritize clear reconstructible geometry and unobstructed silhouette over cinematic atmosphere.

Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is the exact identity reference for Casa de las Lindes. Generate ONE separate reverse exterior three-quarter view of this EXACT SAME building, seen from the rear and its LEFT gable end, rotating camera 180 degrees around the building from the reference. Preserve exact proportions, stonework style, timber extension height, steep blue-grey shingle roof, ridge timber, chimney location (chimney is at the left end viewed from front, therefore near the visible left gable end in this reverse view), palette and stylized painterly material treatment. Do NOT mirror the front or invent another entrance porch. Back long facade is simple: two small rectangular ochre glass windows, no door, no canopy, no steps. Left gable end has the stone chimney rising along wall, one narrow window offset beside chimney. Front porch belongs on the far hidden side, never relocate it onto back. Entire house visible with generous margins, long-lens near orthographic camera elevation 15 degrees, all edges and materials clear. Soft neutral studio lighting, same light warm grey seamless background. No cutaways, collage, panels, labels, text, furniture, terrain base, plants, people, animals, creatures, smoke, fire, magical glow, bloom or fog. This is a reconstruction reference, preserve building identity with maximum geometric consistency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE architectural interior concept image of Casa de las Lindes in EROMASH, matching the ancient stone and dark timber house in the two reference images. This is a DESIGN CUTAWAY to select furniture assets later, not a reconstruction view of exterior. Single room cartographer's study, rectangular footprint, compact believable space. Elevated three-quarter dollhouse view with roof and two nearest walls removed cleanly, showing whole floor and two rear walls, no panels or text. Clear open central circulation. Three principal separated furniture objects with space around each: sturdy dark timber map table with one flat parchment map, freestanding wooden drying rack with three large parchment maps hanging neatly, waist-high glazed wooden display cabinet containing a few large brass surveying instruments. Rear stone wall has modest stone hearth aligned with left-end chimney, simple small amber-glass windows; dark timber structural extension and beams above stone. Few rolled maps on a wall shelf, one plain wooden stool. Broad worn stone floor slabs. Nordic dark fantasy with stylized painterly game materials, simplified expressive solid forms, restrained detail, grey-green stone #737C77, dark brown wood, blue-grey accents, ochre parchment. One small ancient carved lintel with flat pale cyan rune inlay, no magical glow. Soft clear neutral lighting illuminating every object, no theatrical shadows. Light warm grey empty background outside cutaway. No people, animals, living entities, plants, vegetation, humanoid statues, flames, smoke, fog, text, labels, watermark. Avoid clutter and intricate tiny objects. Furniture visibly independent, not fused into architecture. House interior should feel like a maintained woodland surveyor's workplace, not a tavern, wizard laboratory or palace.
nota: Referencias conceptuales, no integradas al juego. Vistas generadas, no proyecciones de una malla única; revisar consistencia de chimenea antes de multivista. Interior orientativo.
